item.title: Iran’s exports to Afghanistan up 32% in weight
item.description: Taybad, IRNA – The weight of goods exported to Afghanistan through the Dogharoun border crossing in northeastern Iran increased by 32% in the first seven months of the current Iranian calendar year (March 21-October 22) compared to the same period last year, a local customs official says.

item.title: Iran will take all necessary measures to break US blockade: Deputy FM
